newsitem.title: FRANCE: EU exporters bid for 19,100 T malt with refund.
newsitem.headline: EU exporters bid for 19,100 T malt with refund.

text.p: European exporters have applied since September 12 to export 19,100 tonnes of unroasted malt at a refund of 32.50 Ecus per tonne, an official at the European malt industry association Euromalt said on Monday.
British maltsters applied to export 15,000 tonnes of malt while French maltsters bid for 4,100 tonnes, the official said.
The European Commission has three days to accept or reject the bids.
The European Commission last Thursday set annual refunds of 32.50 Ecus per tonne for unroasted barley malt, 38 Ecus for roasted barley malt and zero for wheat malt.
But it also agreed to revert to a monthly review system for malt export refunds.
